signature.name: The station run
signature.shot: The unit enters a station; its parts move in turn (a gate drops 20 px in 6 f, a press comes down 30 px and lifts in 14 f) and the unit leaves transformed, its top face changing state on the press's contact frame with a 2 f squash; the camera trucks with it, lets it run ahead 0.4 s and catches up at the next station.
signature.build: Relief method in SVG for the set and the unit (about 80 blocks); station parts are blocks whose height or offset follows a keyframed curve; the unit's position along the track is closed form (s(f) with eased stops); the contact squash from squash(); the camera follows with carry; near and far bands are two baked stills, never a live blur.

directions.name: Foreground pass
directions.idea: Life passes in front of the lens, and every time it clears, the product has already done its job behind it.

story.line: A day passes in the foreground; behind it the problem is solved in the gaps, one pass at a time, without anyone stopping.

world.set: Three planes: a far product world, a middle plane with the subject, and a near plane of large dark shapes from the user's day (a door frame, a calendar page, a phone's edge, a shoulder) that slide sideways across the frame and hide it. Every pass is lateral: nothing comes toward the lens.

world.light: The far world lies in a soft pool; the occluders pass in front of it as silhouettes 0.15 L darker, so each pass is a shadow crossing the light.
world.light_build: plate-light method: one pool plate on the far layer; occluders are flat dark plates.
world.texture: clean

camera.between: Motion-masked swaps: the change happens behind the occluder on its full-cover frames; no visible cut.

directions.name: Resolution
directions.idea: The product's images arrive out of coarse blocks; resolution is the film's measure of quality.

story.line: A picture nobody can read; each halving of the cells is one thing the product does; at full resolution it is the result.

world.set: A flat world where the product's images and its screen start as coarse square cells (8-64 px) and resolve by halving on the beat; each cell is the true average of the image under it, and the edges between resolved and unresolved areas are crisp cell edges.
world.planes: 2: the resolving layer and the clean layer beneath it, moving at different creep rates
world.light: Each halving step lifts the frame a fraction toward its final contrast; the last step is a one-frame lift.
world.light_build: exposure-plate method: a plate whose opacity steps down with each halving (0.12, 0.08, 0.04, 0).
world.texture: clean; cells on whole pixels

palettes.notes: coarse cells carry the image's own averages; the accent only at full resolution
the images on a dark stage
a mid slate ground framing the images

type_options.notes: the hero word survives being built of cells
clean shapes at coarse resolutions

camera.animator: The cell size: halving on the beat, the cell front crossing; the camera snap-zooms on the step frames.
camera.in_shot: A held frame with a creep; a snap zoom on a step.
camera.between: A cell front from a word opens the next scene; hard cuts on the downbeat between images.

cuts.grammar: Stepped and on sound: every resolution step on a music event, declared as stepped.
cuts.on_sound: Each halving on a 16th; the final resolve on the downbeat.

type.scale_contrast: A hero word built of resolving cells against a small clean line.
type.behaviour: Read copy is always fully resolved; only the hero word may resolve cell by cell, and it reads before it moves.

signature.name: The cell front
signature.shot: From the word the product names, a square of resolved image grows outward by whole 36 px cells, one ring of cells per frame, reaching the frame's corners in 30 f. Only the two rings at its edge are coarse (36 px, then 18 px cells); inside, the next image is already at full resolution, outside it the old one is still clean, so a stepped square of sharpening crosses the frame.
signature.build: Cells drawn only in the two edge rings as SVG rects whose colours were sampled at build time from low-resolution stills of both images; the resolved square is a clip-path inset of the next image whose half-size is (f - f0) x 36 px, snapped to the cell grid; cells on whole pixels; declared stepped.

signature_alt.name: The scan resolve
signature_alt.shot: A band 120 px tall moves down the image in 24 f: above it the image is resolved, below it coarse 32 px cells, inside it 8 px cells.
signature_alt.build: Three baked stills (32 px, 8 px, full) stacked, each clipped by a clip-path inset tied to the band's position; band edges on whole cells; declared stepped.

lockup.shot: The mark resolves from four cells to exact in four steps on the last bar; the name is clean from its first frame.
lockup.build: Four baked stills of the supplied logo at falling resolution swapped on whole frames; the name in Words.

directions.name: Sundial
directions.idea: The week stands on a floor as blocks of days, and one day passes over it while the film plays.

story.line: Dawn on a crowded week; the sun crosses; by evening the product has made room, and the long shadows fall on a week with space in it.

world.set: Five to seven day-blocks (each a slab as high as that day is full, its top carrying the day's meetings as raised tiles) stand on a mid-tone floor seen from 40 degrees above; the product's focus block stands tallest at the centre like a gnomon. The sun crosses a whole day: a low morning key on the left, over the top, a low evening key on the right.
world.planes: 3: the floor, the day-blocks with their tiles, and the sweeping shadows
world.light: Sun azimuth -80 to +80 degrees and elevation 6, 62, 6 over the film; shadow lengths and directions follow; the floor lightness follows elevation (0.62 at dawn to 0.74 at noon), one hue.
world.light_build: relief method with the key from two functions of the frame (azimuth, elevation); the floor tone an exposure plate tied to elevation.
world.texture: the floor material as one static grain plate at 2 %

palettes.notes: mid stone floor and blocks; meeting tiles in ink at 70 %; the focus block's top in the accent
a slate week; tiles in near-white
a pale week; shadows in ink at 18 %

type_options.sans: a neutral grotesk with tabular figures

camera.animator: Time: the sun crosses and the shadows sweep; the camera only creeps and cranes a few degrees.
camera.in_shot: A creep of 1-3 % per second and a crane of 2-5 degrees over the film; the sun never stops.
camera.between: No cuts inside the day; act changes are carried by the light (dawn, noon, evening) and cut on the music only at the turn.

cuts.grammar: Carried by the sun: the day is one continuous light; at most one hard cut, at noon.
cuts.on_sound: Soft ticks as tiles slide into place, grouped by day; noon is the music's turn.

type.scale_contrast: Day names at caption size on the floor against the blocks; one line (84) in the cleared space.
type.behaviour: Lines are printed on the floor and read while the shadow is off them; a shadow never crosses a line during its read.

signature.name: The shadow week
signature.shot: The focus block's shadow sweeps across the floor from Monday's block to Friday's in 3 s as the sun swings 100 degrees; each day the shadow edge crosses, its scattered meeting tiles slide together (12 f each, settleOut) into the gaps the product found, and the cleared stretch lies in the shadow as one long block of focus time.
signature.build: Relief method: day-blocks and tiles as SVG prisms; the focus block's shadow is its footprint hull moved h x cot(e) along the sun's azimuth; a tile moves when the shadow edge crosses its centre (a per-tile trigger frame computed in closed form from the azimuth curve); everything else follows the sun's two angle functions.

signature_alt.name: The long noon
signature_alt.shot: The sun stops overhead for 1.5 s, every shadow gone; the product's changes happen in that shadowless still, then the evening light throws the new week's shadows.
signature_alt.build: The same relief rig with the elevation curve held at 62 degrees; tiles move on a stagger during the hold.

lockup.shot: The sun sets: the last low ray at 3 degrees rakes across the floor and catches only the mark, cut into the floor as a shallow relief; the name lies beside it in the last light.
lockup.build: The supplied logo as a raised footprint 4 px high in the relief method, the only block the 3-degree key still reaches; the name in Words.

directions.name: Footage reel
directions.idea: Real footage breathes with the music, and the product's type locks onto it.

story.line: Footage ramps on the music, each ramp a little faster, until the product's moment freezes on the peak.

world.set: Real supplied footage, graded into one cool duotone toward the accent hue (ink to paper through one hue) and speed-ramped on the music; flat type and product UI sit on top, locked to points in the footage.
world.planes: 2-3: the footage, the anchored type, and product UI between them
world.light: A frame-wide lift on each ramp's peak; at the payoff the footage develops from the duotone to a restrained grade that keeps chroma at 0.06 or less outside the accent's hue family.
world.light_build: exposure-plate method on each peak; the duotone a static SVG feColorMatrix on the video layer, the payoff grade a second static matrix mixed in by opacity.
world.texture: a global grain at 1.5 % that marries footage and flat graphics

camera.between: Speed-ramp joins on the peak; shape match cuts between clips; type carried across the cut as an anchored overlay.

directions.name: Chain reaction
directions.idea: Every step the product automates is a standing slab, and the film is one push that topples them all.

story.line: One tap; each step knocks over the next; the chain runs the whole flow without a hand, and the last slab starts the result.

world.set: A line of 12-30 standing slabs (each a step of the product's flow, its face showing that step) winds across a mid-tone floor in a gentle S, seen from a low three-quarter angle under a raking key; each slab 1.6x as tall as it is wide and 0.2x as deep.
world.planes: 3: the floor, the slab line, and the shadows that shorten as slabs fall
world.light: One key at 22 degrees from the right: standing slabs throw long shadows along the line; a falling slab's shadow shrinks to its footprint as it lands, so the chain reads as shadows collapsing in order.
world.light_build: relief method with each slab drawn from its pivot angle; one shadow path per frame in a group at opacity 0.2.
world.texture: the floor material as one static grain plate at 2 %

palettes.notes: mid stone slabs and floor; each landed face shows its step done; the last slab in the accent
slate slabs with near-white faces
a deep-hue floor; slabs one step lighter in the same hue

type_options.notes: step names on the slab faces at ui size

type_options.sans: a technical sans with tabular figures
type_options.notes: a machine feel

camera.animator: The chain: slabs fall in order at a steady rate; the camera follows the falling front with a lag.
camera.in_shot: A follow at the front's speed (5 slabs a second) with a slow crane of 4-8 degrees.
camera.between: One take: the chain is continuous; the camera only rises to the overview as the last slab falls.

cuts.grammar: One take: the chain never cuts; at most one hard cut, to the result the last slab starts.
cuts.on_sound: One click per contact on a steady subdivision, accents every fourth slab; the last impact is the hit.

type.scale_contrast: Step names on the slab faces at ui size against one line (84) on the floor where the chain pauses.
type.behaviour: The chain pauses once, at a slab leaning on the next, for the one read; nothing else holds.

signature.name: The topple
signature.shot: One tap tips the first slab; each slab falls 75 degrees in 14 f, accelerating like a real fall, and strikes the next on its contact frame, so the chain runs at a steady 5 slabs a second while the camera follows the front with a 0.3 s lag. Each slab's face, as it lands, shows its step done; the last falls onto a plate that starts the product's result.
signature.build: Relief method in SVG: each slab a box drawn from its pivot angle a(f) (four visible faces projected); a_i(f) = an ease-in square fall curve starting at t0 + i x 12 f, contact at t0 + i x 12 + 9 f (closed form, no simulation); shadows from the key; face-shade per face; the camera carry-follows the front with a 0.3 s lag.

directions.name: Shadow play
directions.idea: A light, a wall and the product's objects: the shadows tell the story, and the object casting them is the turn.

story.line: The wall shows a frightening shadow; the object casting it moves toward the wall and turns, and the shadow becomes the product's clean shape.

world.set: One mid-tone wall fills the frame, lit by a single point light off-frame at the lower left. Between the light and the wall, the product's objects (cut-out silhouettes of its controls, cards and units) move on their own planes; mostly only their shadows are seen, sharp when close to the wall, large and soft when close to the light.
world.planes: 3: the wall, the shadows on it, and a near object plane (pre-softened, sometimes crossing frame)
world.light: One point light at a fixed position: each shadow scales by wall distance over light distance and softens with the same ratio; the wall falls off 0.10 L away from the light's axis.
world.light_build: projection method for the shadows; the wall falloff from plate-light.
world.texture: the wall's matte surface as one static grain plate at 2 %

palettes.notes: a mid stone wall lit to L .80 near the light axis; shadows ink at 55 %; the accent only on the product's one real object
a slate wall; shadows near-black; type near-white
a deep-hue wall; shadows in the same hue at L .22

type_options.notes: printed on the wall, and it casts no shadow
plain, so the shadows stay the picture

camera.animator: The objects between light and wall: they move nearer and farther and turn; the camera drifts along the wall.
camera.in_shot: A lateral drift of 6-20 px/s along the wall; shadows keep moving with their objects.
camera.between: A shadow grows until it covers the wall and the next scene is in its shape (a mask seam); a defocus seam when an object passes close to the light.

cuts.grammar: Carried by shadows: covers, shrinks and turns; one hard cut at the reveal of the real object.
cuts.on_sound: A low swell as a shadow grows; the turn lands on one clean hit.

type.scale_contrast: One line (84) printed on the wall against shadows from hand size to the whole frame.
type.behaviour: Lines are printed on the lit wall away from moving shadows; a shadow never crosses a line during its read.

signature.name: The reveal turn
signature.shot: A huge soft shadow fills the wall: the problem, a tangle. The object casting it moves from the light toward the wall over 40 f, so the shadow shrinks x4 and sharpens, and in its last 12 f it turns 90 degrees about its vertical axis: the tangle's silhouette resolves into the product's clean shape.
signature.build: Projection method: the object is 8-20 flat cut-out pieces in one preserve-3d group; its shadow is the same group drawn a second time through a planar projection matrix3d from the light onto the wall, filled ink at 55 %; turning the group turns the shadow exactly; softness from two copies (sharp, and one with a constant 14 px blur) mixed by defocusMix of the distance ratio.

signature_alt.name: The swallow
signature_alt.shot: Two shadows share the wall, the old way small and sharp, the product's soft and far; the product's object moves toward the light and its shadow grows x3 until it covers the old one.
signature_alt.build: The same projection rig with the product's object moving toward the light; defocusMix as it nears it.

lockup.shot: The last object turns and its shadow is the mark; the object itself never enters the frame; the name is printed on the wall beside the shadow.
lockup.build: Cut-out pieces whose projection at the final angle is the supplied logo's silhouette (designed backwards from the logo); the name in Words on the wall.

directions.name: The statement
directions.idea: The words are the picture: one line at full size on a clean field, built word by word on the beat, and the product answers it full frame.

story.line: The line calls (the problem in a few words); the product answers full frame; the line calls again, shorter; the answer is the result; the last word left on the field is the name.

world.set: A clean flat field fills the frame: no texture, no plate, no footage behind a read. The copy is set frontal and centred at 9-12 % of the frame height, one line at a time, and the product appears full frame on the same field between lines, its real interface at reading size.
world.planes: 2: the field and the type, or the field and the full-frame product (its window on a soft 30 % ink shadow plate)
world.light: A frame-wide exposure event: on the payoff word the whole field flips in one frame from the ground to the accent field and the type turns near-white, then holds; every other shot keeps the plain ground.
world.light_build: exposure-plate method: one full-frame plate in the accent, opacity stepped 0 to 1 on the beat frame (a declared colour seam); the type's colour swaps on the same frame.
world.texture: clean: one flat colour, no grain plate and no texture

palettes.notes: near-black type on a white field; the accent is the payoff field and the one word that changed
near-white type on a dark stage; the payoff floods the field in the accent
a mid slate field with near-white type; the accent field arrives on the payoff

type_options.sans: a neutral grotesk at a bold weight
type_options.notes: tight tracking (-0.02 em) at display size; the line at 9-12 % of the frame height, one line at a time
round open counters, so a word read on a 240 px strip still reads

camera.animator: The type and the product move; the camera locks for every read and pushes only into the product.
camera.in_shot: Locked for each read (0.5-1 s still while the next word builds); a 4-6 % push into the full-frame product over its beat.
camera.between: Hard cuts on the beat between a line and the product; the line re-centres as each word lands.

cuts.grammar: Hard cuts on beats between the line and the product; each word lands on a beat; one colour seam on the payoff.
cuts.on_sound: Every word lands on a beat; the cut to the product lands on a downbeat; the field flips on the track's biggest hit.

type.scale_contrast: The line at 9-12 % of the frame height (100-130 px), the largest thing in its shots; the product full frame between lines; one hero word at 22 % on the payoff.
type.behaviour: One line at a time, frontal and centred, built word by word on the beat (each word whole on its first frame, never letter by letter); the line re-centres with most of the move on frame one; nothing moves during a read but the next word arriving.

signature.name: The built line
signature.shot: On four consecutive beats one word each cuts on at full size, centred and frontal on the flat field (the line at 11 % of the frame height, each word whole on its first frame); the line re-centres 70 % of its shift on frame one; on the fourth beat the field flips to the accent in 1 f and the type to near-white, and the line holds still for 0.8 s.
signature.build: Words in one flex row (mode build, recentre jump) on a plain div field; the field flip is one full-frame plate whose opacity steps 0 to 1 on the beat frame (accentFade over 1 f); no transform on the field.

signature_alt.name: The step stack
signature_alt.shot: Three lines stack downward, each cut on a beat at a smaller size (14 %, 10 % and 7 % of the frame height), left-aligned on the field, then the stack clears in one frame.
signature_alt.build: Three Words rows in a column, each cut on whole; the clear is one hard cut to the empty field.

lockup.shot: The last line's words leave on one frame except the last, which is the name; the mark cuts on beside it on the next beat, the unit frontal and centred on the clean field at 45 % of the frame width, held 1 s.
lockup.build: Lockup placed by lockupLayout (mark and name as one centred unit) on the plain field; the other words removed on one frame; Words for the name.

directions.name: The slot line
directions.idea: One fixed phrase stays centred on a clean field while its last word rolls on the beat, and every new word opens the product full frame doing exactly that.

story.line: One phrase, many endings: each rolled word is one thing the product does, shown full frame; the last word the slot lands on is the name.

world.set: A clean flat field; one phrase set frontal at 9 % of the frame height with a word slot at its end (a window the width of the longest word, a 1 px hairline under it). Between rolls the product fills the frame on the same field and steps back (scaled 0.9, softened one step) while the phrase reads on the field above it: no veil over the product.
world.planes: 2-3: the field, the phrase with its slot, the full-frame product under its veil
world.light: Each roll lands with a one-step exposure lift inside the slot (0.06 over 0.4 s) and the newest word takes the accent, so the eye goes to it without a lit patch behind the line; the field stays clean.
world.light_build: exposure-plate method: the slot's own plate lifts on each landing frame; the word's colour swaps on the same frame.
world.texture: clean

palettes.notes: ink phrase on a neutral paper; the slot word in the accent

camera.animator: The slot rolls and the product runs; the camera holds still and racks focus between the phrase and the product.
camera.in_shot: Locked; a rack (defocusMix 0 to 8 px over 14 f) moves the read from the phrase to the product and back; a 3 % push over each product beat.
camera.between: Carried: the roll's speed carries into the product's first move (launch into the roll, carry out of it).

cuts.grammar: The roll is the seam: each word rolls up out of the slot at speed and the product's first move carries that speed; one hard cut on the payoff.
cuts.on_sound: Each roll lands on a beat; the product's state change lands on the next one.

type.scale_contrast: The phrase at 9 % of the frame height over a full-frame product: the type and the product each own the frame in turn.
type.behaviour: The phrase never moves; only the slot word rolls (a masked vertical roll of 10-14 f, whole words, never letters), and the phrase holds still for each read.

signature.name: The slot roll
signature.shot: The slot word rolls up out of its window in 12 f (a masked roll on snapOut, the new word whole on its first frame at 9 % of the frame height) on the beat; as it lands, the product behind the phrase cuts to the state that word names, its first move carrying the roll's 40 px/f; four rolls over 4 bars, each 0.5 s sooner than the last.
signature.build: Roll (a masked vertical roll inside a clip-path window the slot's width) for the word; the product layer swaps with swapAt on the landing frame and moves with carriedCut; the phrase is one Words row that never moves.

signature_alt.name: The ghost reel
signature_alt.shot: The slot shows the neighbouring words as dim ghosts above and below at 30 % ink, so each roll reads as a reel that stops on the chosen word.
signature_alt.build: The Roll's clip-path window opened to three lines, the outer two at 30 % opacity.

lockup.shot: The slot rolls one last time, to the name; the phrase leaves on one frame, the name re-centres with the mark beside it, the unit centred on the clean field at 40 % of the frame width, held 1 s.
lockup.build: Roll (its clip-path window) for the last word; Lockup placed by lockupLayout for the centred unit with Words for the name; the phrase removed on one frame.
